title: EDM EMOTION Domain (v0.9 DRAFT)
description: The affect itself: category, valence, arousal, intensity, meta-emotion, bodily sensation, temporal profile and appraisal (v0.8.3 constellation emotion fields + gravity.valence / emotional_weight + impulse urgency / agency_level). valence, arousal, urgency and control are coded text without a numeric value (R5 2026-10-18); intensity keeps the v0.8.3 numeric weight.

primary.description: The dominant emotional quality expressed in the experience
primary.x_constraints: Canonical values: joy, sadness, fear, anger, wonder, peace, tenderness, reverence, pride, anxiety, gratitude, longing, hope, shame, disappointment, relief, frustration. Free text accepted.

x_run1.source: experiments/2026-10-17/RESULTS.md section 1.1 (pooled, 150 texts, frozen thresholds of experiment-plan.md section 4.1)

x_comparability_basis.source: experiments/2026-10-17/RESULTS.md section 1.1 (pooled, 150 texts, frozen thresholds of experiment-plan.md section 4.1)
x_comparability_basis.why: run-1 pass; agreement measured over all answers (no populated-only figure for this shape)
x_comparability_basis.lead_unit_why: the field is itself the scored unit

primary.x_profile_rule: R17 (2026-10-18): profile membership is derived from the comparability class, not chosen. Essential = every affective field classed "comparable" (run-1 pass on populated answers, or run-2 pass); Extended = Essential + "interpretive" + "null-driven"; Full = all 47; partner profiles select freely from their base. Field class = class of the lead unit (LEAD_UNIT); sub-members ride with their field. Computed in scripts/v09_layout.py (COMPARABILITY, PROFILES_09); nothing hand-listed.

secondary.description: Secondary emotional nuances that add depth to the primary emotion, including any complex or layered state (v0.8.3 emotion_subtone + higher_order_emotion)
secondary.x_constraints: 0-5 items; free text; each item may carry codings with a per-coding confidence
